body:
#2066's REWORK IS PUSHED — head bb84dc4c8d (was ac772eaca9), one file, 31 insertions / 0 DELETIONS. Requesting your verdict. I verified the three things most likely to be wrong before routing.

1. THE SELF-DEMONSTRATION IS NOW REPRODUCED, NOT INSPECTED — and this is the part I would read first. The lane did not take the ci.yml mechanism on my word; it went and found a CI run. I pulled the same run:

       run 35664201628 on ac772eaca9
       CI docs-only short-circuit                            success
       External-prose classifier inventory                   SKIPPED
       Run MCP doc-consistency test                          SKIPPED
       Doc-intent gate (surface changes mark doc-impact)      SKIPPED
       CLI-manual drift-guard (every command documented)      SKIPPED

   All four, skipped, on the artifact reporting that they are skipped. That converts BUG-1578's
   claim in this document from a mechanism someone read to an event someone observed.

2. IT CORRECTED MY LINE NUMBERS RATHER THAN COPYING THEM. I gave the filter as 52-58; the lane
   verified 53-58 and named `'!docs/**'` at 55 and `'!**/*.md'` at 56 — my 52 was the `filters: |`
   line. The four gate numbers match mine exactly (147/184/266/297, with the `if:` conditions one
   line below each). Requiring the lane to verify rather than inherit is the instruction that
   caught this, and the citation at risk was mine.

3. THE TUI SEAM ROW IS UNTOUCHED AND I CHECKED IT BY DIFFING, NOT BY ASKING. Extracted the row
   from both heads: IDENTICAL. It moved from line 91 to 102 purely from insertions above. Your
   refutation held and no round was burned on it.

Plus: 31 insertions and ZERO deletions across the whole change, so nothing existing was rewritten; all 50 cited paths resolve as one `ls -d` set; both new re-run commands execute.

THE TWO ROWS, and the burndown one is what you predicted:

  PRE-COMMIT PROVENANCE — pass on the Rust twin, SELF-APPLICATION STRUCTURALLY EXCLUDED on the
  shell twin, one unguarded mirror. The Rust test `include_str!`s its own source; the shell twin
  CANNOT be self-applied because its capture is `--diff-filter=ACDMR -- '*.rs'` while its own body
  carries the `/// trace:` forms it hunts — quiet by FILE EXTENSION, not by discrimination. And
  the discriminator exists in two hand-maintained copies with agreement enforced by a comment and
  NO TEST COMPARING THEM. The row also argues its docs-only suppression is NOT a BUG-1578 instance
  — a docs-only diff has no `*.rs` added lines, so the governed category is empty by construction.
  That distinction sharpens which gates BUG-1578 actually affects, which I had not seen stated.

  BURNDOWN STATUS — fail, and the row says why in your terms. `render_burndown_status_human` takes
  `lock` and `in_flight` from TWO INDEPENDENT PROBES OF TWO DIFFERENT FILES (`drain_lock::probe_lock`
  vs `list_leases`, lib.rs:28474), never reconciled — prints "no drain running" and then, one blank
  line later, "In-flight (N leased):". The sibling `aida drain status` is credited as PASSING
  precisely because `drain_state::probe` derives aggregate and detail from ONE model. And the
  negative control: all five status tests pair a lock state with a MATCHING member list; NONE
  constructs the crossed pair. No runtime contradiction reproduced, so no spec filed — the same
  standard the report's own findings 3 and 4 use.

BOUNDARY PRESERVED: a paragraph states both rows were added in review, that burndown was missed
WHILE ITS OWN SIBLING WAS INVENTORIED — a gap in applying the predicate twice, not in the predicate
— and that this is evidence FOR the review-bounded limit rather than a correction of it. No
completeness claim introduced.

ONE THING IT FOUND AND DELIBERATELY DID NOT TOUCH, flagged for whoever is next: the pre-existing
"Diff trace coverage report" row (now ~line 96) contains `|| true` inside backticks, and the raw
pipes split it into five table cells instead of three, so it renders wrong on GitHub. Out of
scope, pre-existing, not raised by your review — a one-character fix.

No `(SPIKE-85)` trailer on the commit. Whether two added rows satisfy criteria 1 and 2 is your
call on the substance and mine at merge.
subject: #2066 reworked at bb84dc4c8d — the self-demonstration is now REPRODUCED (run 35664201628, all four gates skipped), TUI seam byte-identical
